name: Genetic Multiple Congenital Anomalies/Dysmorphic Syndrome Without Intellectual Disability
aliases: Multiple Congenital Anomalies Syndrome without Cognitive Impairment

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Genetic Multiple Congenital Anomalies/Dysmorphic Syndrome Without Intellectual Disability

criteria.description: Presence of multiple congenital structural anomalies affecting at least two different organ systems
Characteristic craniofacial and skeletal dysmorphic features consistent with syndrome phenotype
Absence of intellectual disability confirmed by standardized cognitive testing
Identification of pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant in associated gene(s) by molecular genetic testing
Exclusion of other syndromes with intellectual disability and overlapping phenotypes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of multiple congenital anomalies and distinctive dysmorphic features with confirmed normal intellectual function
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing can support diagnosis but is not mandatory if clinical criteria are met.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Distinctive craniofacial dysmorphism including hypertelorism and broad nasal bridge
pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic facial gestalt aids clinical recognition
searchTerms: distinct facial features with wide eyes and broad nose
unusual face shape including broad nasal bridge

pathognomonic.symptomName: Multiple congenital skeletal anomalies including clinodactyly and brachydactyly
searchTerms: birth defects affecting bones and fingers

pathognomonic.symptomName: Normal cognitive development without intellectual disability
pathognomonic.notes: Differentiates from syndromes with intellectual impairment

common.symptomName: Congenital cardiac malformations such as atrial septal defect

searchTerms: mild eye problems like crossed eyes
problems with sucking or swallowing in infancy

occasional.symptomName: Renal anomalies such as unilateral renal agenesis

searchTerms: temporary low blood sugar in newborn

rare.symptomName: Hematological abnormalities such as mild thrombocytopenia

searchTerms: mild immune weakness with repeated infections
frequent infections due to mild immunodeficiency

laboratory: Standardized cognitive testing confirming normal intellectual function
imaging: Skeletal radiographs showing characteristic bone anomalies
genetic: Pathogenic variants identified in associated genes by exome or targeted sequencing
other: Detailed clinical examination revealing distinctive dysmorphic features
Developmental assessments confirming normal cognitive milestones

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic cardiac defects such as pulmonary valve stenosis
Short stature with intellectual disability in some cases

redFlags: Severe congenital heart defects requiring urgent intervention
references: Orphanet: Genetic Multiple Congenital Anomalies/Dysmorphic Syndrome Without Intellectual Disability, ORPHA:330206
Smith’s Recognizable Patterns of Human Malformation, 7th Edition
